description_en: Queries the information about a DataWorks workspace
description_zh: 查询一个DataWorks工作空间的信息
name: GetProjectDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
parameters.name: project_id

DefaultDiResourceGroupIdentifier.description_en: The identifier of the default data integration resource group for nodes
DefaultDiResourceGroupIdentifier.description_zh: 默认节点的数据集成资源组标识

DevelopmentType.description_en: The project development type. The value is 4
DevelopmentType.description_zh: 项目开发类型，目前均为4

DisableDevelopment.description_en:
Indicates whether the development role is disabled. Valid values:
false (default): The development role is enabled.
true: The development role is disabled
DisableDevelopment.description_zh:
是否禁用开发角色，取值如下：
false：默认值，开启开发角色。
true：禁用开发角色

EnvTypes.description_en: The environments contained in the workspace. A workspace in basic mode contains only the production environment (PROD). A workspace in standard mode contains the development environment (DEV) and the production environment (PROD)
EnvTypes.description_zh: 工作空间包含的环境：简单模式只有生产环境（PROD），标准模式包含开发环境（DEV）和生产环境（PROD）

items.description_en: The environments contained in the workspace. A workspace in basic mode contains only the production environment (PROD). A workspace in standard mode contains the development environment (DEV) and the production environment (PROD)
items.description_zh: 工作空间包含的环境：简单模式只有生产环境（PROD），标准模式包含开发环境（DEV）和生产环境（PROD）

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the workspace was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the workspace was last modified

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the workspace is the default workspace. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认工作空间，取值如下：
1，是。
0，否

ProjectMode.description_en: The workspace mode. A value of 2 indicates basic mode. A value of 3 indicates standard mode
ProjectMode.description_zh: 工作空间模式：简单工作空间模式为2，标准工作空间模式为3

ProjectName.description_en: The display name of the workspace

ProjectOwnerBaseId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud ID of the workspace owner
ProjectOwnerBaseId.description_zh: 工作空间所有者的阿里云ID

ProtectedMode.description_en: Indicates whether protected mode is enabled for the workspace
ProtectedMode.description_zh: 工作空间是否开启了保护模式

ResidentArea.description_en: The type of the workspace. A value of private indicates a private zone. A value of swap indicates a swap zone
ResidentArea.description_zh: 工作空间的类型：private为私有区，swap为交换区

SchedulerMaxRetryTimes.description_en: The default maximum number of automatic reruns upon an error
SchedulerMaxRetryTimes.description_zh: 默认出错自动重跑的次数

SchedulerRetryInterval.description_en: The default interval between automatic reruns upon an error
SchedulerRetryInterval.description_zh: 默认出错自动重跑的时间间隔

TablePrivacyMode.description_en:
The visibility of MaxCompute tables. Valid values:
0: MaxCompute tables are not visible to tenant users.
1: MaxCompute tables are visible to tenant users
TablePrivacyMode.description_zh:
MaxCompute表的可见性权限，取值如下：
0，租户内用户不可见MaxCompute表。
1，租户内用户可见MaxCompute表

UseProxyOdpsAccount.description_en: Indicates whether a proxy account is used to access the MaxCompute engine
UseProxyOdpsAccount.description_zh: 访问MaxCompute引擎是否使用代理账号

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the workspace information was queried successfully
Success.description_zh: 是否成功查询工作空间的信息
